        "path": "cmd/orchestrator/runtime/nodes.py",

        "text": "        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=pool_width) as pool:\n            futures = [pool.submit(run_and_report, binding) for binding in bindings]\n            results = tuple(future.result() for future in futures)"
      },
      "conclusion": "ConcurrentNodeExecutor 中 future.result() 无超时参数。任一 agent dispatch 挂起会阻塞整个节点，所有 worker 串行等待该 future。此为当前并发分发机制的性能风险：池大小不足以抵御单个慢 worker 拖慢整批。",
      "unknowns": []

      "source": "cmd/orchestrator/runtime/concurrency.py:56-68",
      "quote": {
        "path": "cmd/orchestrator/runtime/concurrency.py",
        "line_start": 56,
        "line_end": 68,
        "text": "class RuntimeConcurrencyAdmission:\n    \"\"\"Thread-safe global/task/phase admission for external workers.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        limits: ConcurrencyLimits | None = None,\n        clock: object | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.limits = limits or ConcurrencyLimits()\n        self.limits.validate()\n        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))\n        self._leases: dict[str, LeaseReceipt] = {}\n        self._logical_keys: dict[AdmissionKey, str] = {}\n        self._lock = threading.RLock()"
      },
      "conclusion": "RuntimeConcurrencyAdmission 使用 threading.RLock 纯内存锁实现租约管理。多实例部署时各进程持有独立 _leases 字典，global_max 和 per_task_max 实际为进程局部限制而非全局协调。门下省并发执行方案在分布式场景下无跨进程准入保护。",
      "unknowns": []
    },
    {
      "evidence_id": "ev-task-20261006-cded0f:worker-03:003",
      "requirement_id": "R-003",
      "decision_relevance": "coverage",

        "line_start": 182,
        "line_end": 210,
        "text": "    prompt_slicing_flag = _env_flag(\"ZHONGSHU_PROMPT_SLICING\")"
      },
      "conclusion": "prompt_slicing 标志在 app.py:182 读取并存储到 domain/context.py:90 的 prompt_slicing 字段，但没有任何领域或运行时逻辑引用该字段来判断是否执行切片。PROMPT_BUNDLE_SECTIONS 计量日志已输出，但切片执行逻辑从未实现，属于已埋点未接入的半成品特性。",
      "unknowns": []

    {

      },
      "conclusion": "_PARALLEL_WORKER_LIMIT_FIELD 仅覆盖 ANALYST 和 CRITIC，Solver（REQUIREMENT_CONTRACT_ONLY 与首次取证后的 Solver 绑定）、ZHONGSHU_FREEZE_CHECK 以及 MENXIA_* 系列状态不在字典中，states.py:1196-1197 回退到 worker_count=1。整体时长优化方案未覆盖这些阶段的并发可能性。",
      "unknowns": []

      "decision_relevance": "risk",

        "line_end": 1338,
        "text": "                        \"prompt_ref\": prompt.content,"

      "conclusion": "dispatch 事件中 prompt_ref 以裸字符串传递整个 prompt.content。Solver 和 Critic 的 prompt bundle 通常超过 100KB，每次派发都重复序列化完整 prompt 到 effect payload 中，增加事件仓储存储体积和传输时间。增量构建已计量但未实现为差异追加。",

        "line_start": 300,
        "line_end": 303,
        "text": "        self.admission = RuntimeConcurrencyAdmission(\n            ConcurrencyLimits(\n                global_max=int(os.environ.get(\"GLOBAL_MAX_WORKERS\", \"6\")),\n                per_task_max=int(os.environ.get(\"PER_TASK_MAX_WORKERS\", \"6\")),"
      },
      "conclusion": "GLOBAL_MAX_WORKERS 和 PER_TASK_MAX_WORKERS 默认均为 6。per_task_max == global_max 意味着单个并发任务可占满全局配额；多任务并行时其他任务分配不到 worker 槽位。门下省并发执行方案下此风险更为突出。",
